final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) as rec_count, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.rec_count, step1.avg_gb_per_min, step1.avg_gb_per_min - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_gb_per_min > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(rec_count) as avg_count, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_ratio, AVG(diff) as avg_difference FROM step3
